sql_query: SELECT SUM(o.sales) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS total_customers, SUM(o.profit) AS total_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(o.sales) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(o.profit) / SUM(o.sales) END AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS DOUBLE) END AS return_rate_pct FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o LEFT JOIN tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_returns r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE (:region IS NULL OR o.region = :region) AND (:segment IS NULL OR o.segment = :segment) AND (:start_date IS NULL OR :end_date IS NULL OR o.order_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date)
kpi_patterns: ["Total Sales", "Total Orders", "Total Customers", "Total Profit", "Profit Margin", "Return Rate %"]
description: Single-row card query returning the six KPI measures (Total Sales, Total Orders, Total Customers, Total Profit, Profit Margin, Return Rate %) with active slicers applied: REGION, SEGMENT, and ORDER_DATE range.

query_name: Total Sales and Total Profit by Year and Quarter
sql_query:
SELECT
  year(o.order_date) AS Year,
  quarter(o.order_date) AS Quarter,
  SUM(o.sales) AS total_sales,
  SUM(o.profit) AS total_profit
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders AS o
WHERE
  ((:region IS NULL) OR o.region = :region)
  AND ((:segment IS NULL) OR o.segment = :segment)
  AND ((:start_date IS NULL AND :end_date IS NULL) OR (o.order_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date))
GROUP BY
  year(o.order_date),
  quarter(o.order_date)
ORDER BY
  year(o.order_date),
  quarter(o.order_date);
description: Dual-axis time series aggregated by Year and Quarter. Applies page slicers: REGION, SEGMENT, ORDER_DATE (start_date/end_date). Uses only the orders table and returns total sales and total profit per Year/Quarter.

query_name: Total Sales by CATEGORY and SUB_CATEGORY
sql_query:
SELECT
  o.category AS CATEGORY,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Accessories' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Accessories,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Appliances' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Appliances,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Art' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Art,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Binders' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Binders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Bookcases' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Bookcases,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Chairs' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Chairs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Copiers' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Copiers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Envelopes' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Envelopes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Fasteners' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Fasteners,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Furnishings' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Furnishings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Labels' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Labels,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Machines' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Machines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Paper' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Paper,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Phones' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Phones
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
WHERE
  (:region IS NULL OR o.region = :region)
  AND (:segment IS NULL OR o.segment = :segment)
  AND ((:start_date IS NULL AND :end_date IS NULL) OR (o.order_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date))
GROUP BY o.category
ORDER BY o.category;
description: Total sales per CATEGORY with one column per SUB_CATEGORY (each column is SUM of sales where sub_category matches). Applies page slicers: region, segment, and order_date range via parameters (:region, :segment, :start_date, :end_date).

sql_query:
SELECT o.segment AS SEGMENT, SUM(o.sales) AS total_sales
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
WHERE (:region IS NULL OR o.region = :region)
  AND (:segment IS NULL OR o.segment = :segment)
  AND ((:start_date IS NULL AND :end_date IS NULL) OR (o.order_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date))
GROUP BY o.segment
ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC
description: Total Sales by SEGMENT (applies REGION, SEGMENT, and ORDER_DATE slicers). Uses SUM(o.sales) grouped by o.segment.
